gripOrHq.title: Startup Immolator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Loan from Chiba
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Forged Activation Orders
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

heapOrArchives.title: Priority Wreck
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Artificial Security Directors
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Black Ops agendas is reduced by 1.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
